$comment: SHRINK-ONLY baseline for verify:invariant-coverage (REGISTER-1). Each entry is a guarded invariant whose DECLARED verify: guard is not reached by any CI job on a pull request — almost always because the proof needs a real database and CI's `check` job is pure. This is a deliberate architecture, not a backlog: DB proofs run against the Demo Winery tenant, and two of them (fk-registry-db, vineyard-scope-db) run in the db-proofs job. Adding an entry must be a deliberate act with a real reason; REMOVING one when the guard becomes CI-reachable is required (the guard fails on a stale entry).
